economy.summary: Introduced the Cost-of-Living Emergency Act with Sen. Mark Kelly, saying the country is in a cost of living emergency. The bill would create a DOJ-FTC task force to investigate price gouging and other pricing practices for essential goods and services.
economy.short: Proposes Cost-of-Living Emergency Act to investigate price gouging on essentials.

taxes.summary: Voted against the 2025 Republican tax-and-spending bill (H.R. 1), calling it fiscally reckless and saying it provided tax giveaways to the wealthiest while adding trillions in debt.
taxes.short: Voted against 2025 GOP tax bill, calling it fiscally reckless.

abortion.summary: Cosponsored the Women's Health Protection Act of 2025 (H.R. 12), which would protect access to abortion services nationwide.
abortion.short: Cosponsors Women's Health Protection Act protecting nationwide abortion access.

education.summary: Pressed the Trump administration to release $230 million in withheld federal K-12 education funding for Pennsylvania schools; his office said his advocacy helped push the administration to release the funds.
education.short: Pressed administration to release withheld federal K-12 school funding.

healthcare.summary: Cosponsored the Medicare for All Act of 2025 (H.R. 3069), which would establish a national single-payer health insurance program.
healthcare.short: Cosponsors Medicare for All single-payer national health insurance bill.

energy.summary: Introduced bipartisan legislation (H.R. 4415) to relocate the Department of Energy's Office of Fossil Energy and Carbon Management to Pittsburgh, a move he said is aimed at lowering energy costs and creating jobs in Pennsylvania.
energy.short: Proposes relocating federal energy office to Pittsburgh, lowering costs.

guns.summary: Supports banning assault weapons and high-capacity magazines, extending background checks to all gun sales, and red flag laws; supported the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act while saying more must be done.
guns.short: Supports assault weapons ban, universal background checks, red flag laws.

economy.summary: His campaign platform calls for pro-growth policies to empower small businesses, reducing Washington's regulatory burden, and stopping what he calls a Washington spending spree that he says led to high inflation.
economy.short: Supports pro-growth small-business policies; opposes Washington spending spree.

taxes.summary: Pledges to get government off people's backs and out of their pockets, says Congress should live within its budget like everyday Americans, and opposes what he calls socialist policies that would bankrupt the country.
taxes.short: Proposes limiting federal spending; opposes policies he calls socialist.

energy.summary: Supports unleashing energy dominance by capitalizing on the region's natural resources, including natural gas development in Pennsylvania.
energy.short: Supports energy dominance through Pennsylvania natural gas development.

guns.summary: Pledges to protect Second Amendment rights and back the police; opposes efforts to defund police and says law enforcement should have the tools, training, and support needed to keep streets safe.
guns.short: Supports Second Amendment rights, backs police; opposes defunding police.
